findings.title: Preserve support for legacy protobuf messages in the codec
findings.why_it_matters: RPCs using messages generated by older protobuf generators fail to marshal or unmarshal because those messages implement the V1 interface but not ProtoReflect. The default codec previously accepted V1 messages, so existing clients and servers can break after upgrading gRPC. Adapt V1 messages to V2 before encoding and decoding and exercise both paths with a V1-only message.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept both protoadapt.MessageV1 and proto.Message in the codec and adapt V1 messages with protoadapt.MessageV2Of; add a legacy-only round-trip test.
evidence: The diff replaces github.com/golang/protobuf/proto.Message with google.golang.org/protobuf/proto.Message, which requires ProtoReflect.

findings.title: Unwrap legacy status detail messages
findings.why_it_matters: Applications that type-assert status details to their older generated message types receive a V2 reflection wrapper instead and their assertions fail. Previously ptypes.DynamicAny unwrapped registered legacy messages to the original V1 type. Converting the result back to its V1 representation preserves the original concrete type.
findings.suggested_fix: Append protoadapt.MessageV1Of(detail), and add a status details round-trip test using a registered V1-only message and a concrete type assertion.
evidence: The former ptypes.UnmarshalAny DynamicAny path uses ptypes.Empty, which returns proto.MessageV1(mt.New().Interface()).

testing_gaps: Focused Go tests were started with the supplied offline caches using the installed Go binary; their results were not available before the review deadline.
